name: Aizubange (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Aizubange town emblem in white: a ring enclosing a stylised character with a small ring at the bottom.
history: Municipal flag of Aizubange, a town in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 21 October 1965; the emblem dates from 16 March 1965.

features.role: Aizubange town emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised character with a small ring at the bottom
